basic_details.job_title: NBT Executive Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: National Book Trust India (NBT) Executive Assistant Notification 2026 has been released on 21 July 2026 on the official website https://www.nbtindia.gov.in. A total of 1 Executive Assistant vacancy has been announced through the NBT Executive Assistant Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years. Age relaxation will be as per government rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's degree in English Honours/Humanities or any graduate with strong English communication skills, Diploma/Certificate in Office Administration or Secretarial Practices, Minimum 3 years experience.
qualification.details: Bachelor's degree in English Honours/Humanities from a recognized university, or any graduate with strong English communication skills. Diploma/Certificate in Office Administration or Secretarial Practices is preferable. Minimum 3 years of experience in office administration, filing, drafting, and noting work in a Government office/educational institution/reputed organization.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NBT Executive Assistant Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.nbtindia.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NBT Executive Assistant Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.nbtindia.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NBT Executive Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the NBT Executive Assistant post is 05-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Executive Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's degree in English Honours/Humanities or any graduate with strong English communication skills. A Diploma/Certificate in Office Administration or Secretarial Practices is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Executive Assistant position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Executive Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 24,365/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Executive Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Executive Assistant post announced by the National Book Trust India.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the experience required for the Executive Assistant role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 3 years of experience in office administration, filing, drafting, and noting work in a Government office, educational institution, or reputed organization is required.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection stages for the NBT Executive Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will include a Written Test, a Skill Test, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for applying to this post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of National Book Trust India, www.nbtindia.gov.in, and links are provided in the Important Links section.
